item.title: Doug Wilson Suggests All Muslims Are Criminals
item.description: As Doug Wilson claims that Muslims are a threat to Western Civilization, Tucker Carlson asks a question: Carlson: Is the problem with the Muslims of Europe that they're too Muslim or that they're criminals? Wilson: Well, that's the same thing.

item.title: Rick Green Says The American Majority Deserves Praise For Expanding Rights To The Minority
item.description: Rick Green, America's self-proclaimed "Constitution Coach," brags that it was men who gave women the right to vote and white men who ended slavery: "That's a good track record, folks. That's something we should be proud of."

item.title: Nick Fuentes Says 'Women Are Made To Be Fucked'
item.description: Nick Fuentes says that "women are made to be fucked": "Women are either mothers, whores, or nuns. No other options. There are no female philosophers. There are no female inventors. There are no female generals or billionaires. They are mothers, whores, nuns. End of list. That's what you can be."

item.title: Alex McFarland Says Restoring The Pride Flag At The Stonewall Memoria Is 'Treason'
item.description: Christian nationalist Alex McFarland fumes that the effort to restore the Pride flag at the National Stonewall Memorial is treason: "To put the rainbow Pride—immoral, heinously, unspeakably vile, globalist wicked Pride flag—to put that on the same plane as the US flag, that is treason."
